name: Helek
title: Son of Gilead from the tribe of Manasseh
summary: Helek was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh, the son of Joseph. He was the founder of the clan of the Helekites, and his descendants received an inheritance in the Promised Land during the division of the land after the conquest of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Registered as a son of Gilead
keyEvents.description: Helek is mentioned as one of the sons of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh. His lineage was recorded among the descendants of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of the Helekites
keyEvents.description: From Helek came the clan of the Helekites, one of the recognized clans within the tribe of Manasseh that was counted in the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Land Allocation to the Sons of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Helek's descendants received an inheritance among the sons of Manasseh when Joshua divided the land of Canaan by casting lots.

keyEvents.title: Part of Manasseh's Genealogical Records
keyEvents.description: Helek is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of the tribe of Manasseh, confirming his place in Israel's history.
